verdict.rationale: Bitwarden offers a substantial programmatic surface. Its CLI is described as "fully-featured" for vault management, `bw serve` exposes the vault as a local REST API, the Public API covers organization admin (members, collections, groups, event logs, policies), and there is an official MCP server. None of the evidence states that the API matches everything the UI can do. The Public API is limited to org-management areas, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: an explicit documented UI/API parity claim, API coverage of client-side features such as vault health reports, a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Bitwarden command-line interface (CLI) is a powerful, fully-featured tool for accessing and managing your vault.
The Bitwarden Public API provides organizations a suite of tools for managing members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies.
documented `bw serve` mode exposes the whole vault as a local RESTful API (Vault Management API)
